export declare const MIN_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_MS = 5000;

export declare const SCHEDULE_LEASE_MS = 30000;

export declare class ScheduleError extends Error {
    readonly code: "schedule_job_invalid" | "schedule_handler_missing" | "schedule_job_not_found" | "schedule_interval_too_short" | "schedule_path_refused";
    constructor(code: "schedule_job_invalid" | "schedule_handler_missing" | "schedule_job_not_found" | "schedule_interval_too_short" | "schedule_path_refused", message: string);
}

export interface ScheduleJobRecord {
    job_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    capability_id: string;
    object_ref: string;
    title: string;
    recurrence: ScheduleRecurrence;
    next_due_at: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    last_wakeup: ScheduleWakeupRecord | null;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export type ScheduleRecurrence = {
    kind: "once";
} | {
    kind: "interval";
    interval_ms: number;
};

export interface ScheduleRegisterInput {
    plugin_id: string;
    capability_id: string;
    object_ref: string;
    title: string;
    due_at: string;
    recurrence?: ScheduleRecurrence;
}

export interface ScheduleTickResult {
    invoked: number;
    failed: number;
    skipped: number;
}

export interface ScheduleWakeupControl {
    readonly signal: AbortSignal;
    beforeEffect(): void;
}

export interface ScheduleWakeupInput {
    job_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    capability_id: string;
    object_ref: string;
    due_at: string;
}

export interface ScheduleWakeupRecord {
    wakeup_id: string;
    job_id: string;
    due_at: string;
    started_at: string;
    finished_at: string;
    status: ScheduleWakeupStatus;
    detail: string | null;
}

export interface ScheduleWakeupReply {
    detail?: string;
    status?: ScheduleWakeupStatus;
}

export type ScheduleWakeupStatus = "ok" | "failed" | "plugin_unavailable";

export declare const scheduleCapabilities: {
    readonly register: HostCapabilityDefinition<ScheduleRegisterInput, ScheduleJobRecord>;
    readonly cancel: HostCapabilityDefinition<{
        job_id: string;
        plugin_id: string;
    }, {
        cancelled: boolean;
    }>;
    readonly setEnabled: HostCapabilityDefinition<{
        job_id: string;
        plugin_id: string;
        enabled: boolean;
    }, ScheduleJobRecord>;
    readonly list: HostCapabilityDefinition<{
        plugin_id?: string;
    }, {
        jobs: ScheduleJobRecord[];
    }>;
};

    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.service.scheduler.v1";
    readonly kind: "service";
